adds.why: This book, volume and section heading is not printed on the leaf. The only marginal text is a cut-off, unreadable strip at the right edge.

adds.quote: Page 15
adds.why: No page number can be read on the leaf.

adds.quote: This weapon is constructed using forged wrought iron
adds.why: The leaf has no text describing the weapon. It shows only the title and the illustration.

adds.quote: The main barrel is one foot and two inches long, with a diameter of two inches and two fen
adds.why: These measurements are not printed on the leaf and cannot be seen in the picture.

adds.quote: It is fitted with a wooden crutch-handle crutch (guai). A slot is carved into the top surface
adds.why: This construction detail is presented as page text but is not on the leaf.

adds.quote: Through this slot, insert three small sub-barrels
adds.why: These instructions are not printed on the leaf.

adds.quote: Each sub-barrel is three inches long and one inch and seven fen in diameter
adds.why: These measurements are not printed on the leaf.

adds.quote: On the top of these sub-barrels are alignment pins
adds.why: This is not printed on the leaf.

adds.quote: The fuse-line fuse (yaoxian) for each sub-barrel is primed, and the chamber is loaded with eight fen
adds.why: This loading instruction is not printed on the leaf.

verdict.leaf: Title 直横銃 in the upper right, above a full-page drawing of a gun on a pointed staff. One bundle of barrels points up, bundles point out to each side, and a burning fuse hangs below. A strip of cut-off marginal characters runs along the right edge.

mistranslated.note: The margin is copied from the transcription ('Treatise on Armament Technology … Diagram of the Fire Bed … 9'). On the scan the legible part of the left margin looks more like '…攻…器圖說' (an illustrated-explanation heading for devices), not 武備志 / 火牀圖. It is at least marked unclear.

adds.quote: Illustrated Explanation of Various Devices, Volume 3
adds.why: This section heading is not printed on the leaf.

adds.quote: The Drum Pillars 鼓柱 (gu zhu) are two in total
adds.why: The whole entry on drum pillars (sizes, threading, how they are fixed) is not on this leaf, which has only the title and the picture.

adds.quote: The Pillar Sleeves 柱套 (zhu tao) are two in total
adds.why: The entry on pillar sleeves (wrought copper, ring, nails) is not printed on the leaf.

adds.quote: it is vital that the fit is loose with ample clearance
adds.why: This continues the made-up mechanism text. It is not on the leaf.

adds.quote: a sophisticated Ming Dynasty multi-barrel weapon system
adds.why: The dating and the judgement 'sophisticated' are neither printed nor visible.

adds.quote: to safeguard the crew from incoming arrows or shot
adds.why: This explains the board's purpose, which goes beyond what the picture shows.

mistranslated.note: The margin is given as definite text ('Treatise on Armament Technology', 'Page Nine') with no unclear marking. The scan's margin looks more like '…攻…器圖說', so these readings are doubtful.

verdict.leaf: Title 火牀圖 above a woodcut of a flat wheeled frame carrying three tubes, with a slanted board at the front; a partly cut-off margin running head reads roughly '…器圖說'.
